name: Sun Cleric temporary Sun Ray: kept with Scorch Marks, refused without its marker, gone with the aura
contract: Sun Cleric ADR 0006 (mentor decisions D-43 and D-46). Burning Heat 704908 streams the Sun Ray 504764 text
"... and granting you Scorch Marks." A player learns Sun Ray temporarily while the marker 803238 is up and the
Sunflare 800231 button turns into Sun Ray. Refresh keeps that temporary Sun Ray while Scorch Marks 807059 is on
the player, because Player::removeSpell strips the aura of every TriggerSpell of the removed spell. The Sun
Cleric cast check refuses a non-triggered Sun Ray from that temporary entry once the marker is gone
(SPELL_FAILED_CANT_DO_THAT_RIGHT_NOW, 173), and the removal of 807059 runs Refresh, so the temporary Sun Ray
ends with the aura, by removal and by expiry (DurationIndex 1, 10000 ms). Control: the same direct Sun Ray cast
with the marker up is accepted.
